sectionHeadings: FR-05: New gates extend both modes
record.summary: Amend spec 104 to introduce a two-mode CI contract: the parity-bound recipe (renamed `make ci-strict` by spec 135) retains strict workflow→Makefile parity; the fast sibling (renamed `make ci` and promoted to default by spec 135) is a parity-exempt, performance-optimised local mirror that covers the same gate set with parallel/accelerated tooling. Reference target: 90+ min → ≤ 25 min warm on M1 Pro 10c / 64 GB (aspirational; measurement required within 7 days of `implementation: complete`).
record.title: Fast Local CI Mode — Two-Mode Parity Contract
